verses.text: Make love your aim, and eagerly desire the gifts of the Spirit, most of all the gift of speaking God's message.
Anyone who speaks in another language is not speaking to people but to God. No one understands them. They are speaking secret things by the Spirit.
But anyone who speaks God's message speaks to people to build them up, encourage them and comfort them.
Anyone who speaks in another language builds up only themselves. But anyone who speaks God's message builds up the church.

I would like all of you to speak in other languages, but I would much rather you spoke God's message. The one who speaks God's message is greater than the one who speaks in other languages, unless someone explains what they say, so that the church may be built up.
Brothers and sisters, if I come to you and speak in other languages, how will I help you? Only if I bring you something God has shown me, or some knowledge, or God's message, or teaching.
Even things without life that make sounds, like a flute or a harp, must play clear notes. Otherwise, how will anyone know what tune is being played?
And if the trumpet does not give a clear call, who will get ready for battle?
It is the same with you. If you do not speak words people can understand, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.
There are many different languages in the world, and every one of them has meaning.
But if I do not understand someone's language, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker is a foreigner to me.
It is the same with you. Since you are eager to have the gifts of the Spirit, try to have plenty of the gifts that build up the church.
So anyone who speaks in another language should pray for the ability to explain what they say.
For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my mind does not understand.
So what shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.
If you praise God only with your spirit, how can someone who does not understand say "Amen" to your prayer of thanks? They do not know what you are saying.
You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other person is not built up.
I thank God that I speak in other languages more than all of you.
But in church I would rather speak five words that people can understand, to teach them, than ten thousand words in another language.
Brothers and sisters, stop thinking like children. Be like babies when it comes to evil, but in your thinking be grown up.
In the law it is written, "The Lord says, I will speak to this people through people of other languages and through the lips of foreigners. But even then they will not listen to me."
So speaking in other languages is a sign, not for believers but for unbelievers. But speaking God's message is a sign, not for unbelievers but for believers.
So if the whole church meets and everyone speaks in other languages, and some outsiders or unbelievers come in, will they not say you are out of your minds?
But if everyone speaks God's message, and an unbeliever or outsider comes in, they will be shown their sin by all, and judged by all.
The secrets of their heart will be brought into the open. Then they will fall down and worship God, saying, "God is really here among you!"

So what should we do, brothers and sisters? When you meet together, one of you has a song, another a teaching, another something God has shown them, another a message in another language, and another an explanation of it. Everything must be done to build up the church.
If anyone speaks in another language, two or at most three should speak, one at a time. And someone must explain what they say.
If there is no one to explain, the speaker should keep quiet in church and speak only to themselves and to God.
Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should think carefully about what is said.
If God shows something to another person who is sitting there, the first speaker should stop.
For you can all speak God's message one by one, so that everyone may learn and be encouraged.
Prophets can control their own spirits.
For God is not a God of disorder but of peace, as in all the churches of God's people.
Women should keep quiet in the churches. They are not allowed to speak, but must be under authority, as the law says.
If they want to ask about something, they should ask their own husbands at home. For it is shameful for a woman to speak in church.
Did the word of God begin with you? Or are you the only people it has reached?
If anyone thinks they are a prophet or have gifts of the Spirit, let them accept that what I am writing to you is the Lord's command.
If anyone ignores this, they themselves will be ignored.
So, my brothers and sisters, be eager to speak God's message, and do not stop people from speaking in other languages.
But everything should be done in a proper and orderly way.
